title: Con fi gure CLAUDE.md fi les with appropriate hierarchy, scoping, and modular organization
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The CLAUDE.md con fi guration hierarchy: user-level (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project-level (.claude/CLAUDE.md or root CLAUDE.md), and directory-level (subdirectory CLAUDE.md fi les)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: user/project/root/subdirectory CLAUDE.md paths.

knowledge.item: That user-level settings apply only to that user—instructions in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md are not shared with teammates via version control
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: user instructions không chia sẻ qua repo.

knowledge.item: The @import syntax for referencing external fi les to keep CLAUDE.md modular (e.g., importing speci fi c standards fi les relevant to each package)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10/CODE02: @file import và context vẫn được nạp.

knowledge.item: .claude/rules/ directory for organizing topic-speci fi c rule fi les as an alternative to a monolithic CLAUDE.md
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: .claude/rules/ theo topic thay file lớn.

skills.item: Diagnosing con fi guration hierarchy issues (e.g., a new team member not receiving instructions because they're in user-level rather than project-level con fi guration)
skills.evidence: EXAM10/16Q1: chẩn đoán team thiếu hướng dẫn do user scope.

skills.item: Using @import to selectively include relevant standards fi les in each package's CLAUDE.md based on maintainer domain knowledge
skills.evidence: EXAM10: chọn @standards/testing.md theo domain package.

skills.item: Splitting large CLAUDE.md fi les into focused topic-speci fi c fi les in .claude/rules/ (e.g., testing.md, api-conventions.md, deployment.md)
skills.evidence: EXAM10: testing/api-conventions/deployment rule files.

skills.item: Using the /memory command to verify which memory fi les are loaded and diagnose inconsistent behavior across sessions
skills.evidence: EXAM10: /memory kiểm tra files loaded.

title: Create and con fi gure custom slash commands and skills
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Project-scoped commands in .claude/commands/ (shared via version control) vs user-scoped commands in ~/.claude/commands/ (personal)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: project .claude/commands so với ~/.claude/commands.

knowledge.item: Skills in .claude/skills/ with SKILL.md fi les that support frontmatter con fi guration including context: fork, allowed-tools, and argument-hint
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: .claude/skills/SKILL.md với frontmatter.

knowledge.item: The context: fork frontmatter option for running skills in an isolated sub-agent context, preventing skill outputs from polluting the main conversation
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10 Q2: context fork cô lập verbose context.

knowledge.item: Personal skill customization: creating personal variants in ~/.claude/skills/ with different names to avoid affecting teammates
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: ~/.claude/skills tên khác bản chia sẻ.

skills.item: Creating project-scoped slash commands in .claude/commands/ for team-wide availability via version control
skills.evidence: EXAM10: project command version-controlled cho nhóm.

skills.item: Using context: fork to isolate skills that produce verbose output (e.g., codebase analysis) or exploratory context (e.g., brainstorming alternatives) from the main session
skills.evidence: EXAM10 Q2: fork cho phân tích/khám phá dài và summary bàn giao.

skills.item: Con fi guring allowed-tools in skill frontmatter to restrict tool access during skill execution (e.g., limiting to fi le write operations to prevent destructive actions)
skills.evidence: EXAM10 Q3: allowed-tools theo workflow, không thay backend validation.

skills.item: Using argument-hint frontmatter to prompt developers for required parameters when they invoke the skill without arguments
skills.evidence: EXAM10 Q3: argument-hint gợi ý tham số, không là validation tuyệt đối.

skills.item: Choosing between skills (on-demand invocation for task-speci fi c work fl ows) and CLAUDE.md (always-loaded universal standards)
skills.evidence: EXAM10/CODE03: CLAUDE.md chuẩn chung, skill workflow theo nhu cầu.

title: Apply path-speci fi c rules for conditional convention loading
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: .claude/rules/ fi les with YAML frontmatter paths fi elds containing glob patterns for conditional rule activation
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: YAML frontmatter paths chứa glob.

knowledge.item: How path-scoped rules load only when editing matching fi les, reducing irrelevant context and token usage
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: rule chỉ khớp phạm vi giảm irrelevant context.

knowledge.item: The advantage of glob-pattern rules over directory-level CLAUDE.md fi les for conventions that span multiple directories (e.g., test fi les spread throughout a codebase)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: glob theo loại file tốt hơn một directory file cho test rải rác.

skills.item: Creating .claude/rules/ fi les with YAML frontmatter path scoping (e.g., paths: ["terraform/**/*"]) so rules load only when editing matching fi les
skills.evidence: EXAM10: paths terraform/**/* giữa --- YAML boundaries.

skills.item: Using glob patterns in path-speci fi c rules to apply conventions to fi les by type regardless of directory location (e.g., **/*.test.tsx for all test fi les)
skills.evidence: EXAM10/16: **/*.test.tsx xuyên package.

skills.item: Choosing path-speci fi c rules over subdirectory CLAUDE.md fi les when conventions must apply to fi les spread across the codebase
skills.evidence: EXAM10 Q1: chọn path rule thay CLAUDE.md chỉ một thư mục con.

title: Determine when to use plan mode vs direct execution
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Plan mode is designed for complex tasks involving large-scale changes, multiple valid approaches, architectural decisions, and multi- fi le modi fi cations
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: plan khi kiến trúc/nhiều file/phương án cạnh tranh.

knowledge.item: Direct execution is appropriate for simple, well-scoped changes (e.g., adding a single validation check to one function)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: direct cho conditional/bug phạm vi rõ.

knowledge.item: Plan mode enables safe codebase exploration and design before committing to changes, preventing costly rework
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10/API30: đọc/plan trước implement để giảm rework.

knowledge.item: The Explore subagent for isolating verbose discovery output and returning summaries to preserve main conversation context
knowledge.evidence: EXAM10: Explore trả summary, giữ verbose discovery ngoài context chính.

skills.item: Selecting plan mode for tasks with architectural implications (e.g., microservice restructuring, library migrations affecting 45+ fi les, choosing between integration approaches with different infrastructure requirements)
skills.evidence: EXAM10: migration45file và phương án hạ tầng cần plan.

skills.item: Selecting direct execution for well-understood changes with clear scope (e.g., a single- fi le bug fi x with a clear stack trace, adding a date validation conditional)
skills.evidence: EXAM10: date conditional một hàm có thể direct.

skills.item: Using the Explore subagent for verbose discovery phases to prevent context window exhaustion during multi-phase tasks
skills.evidence: EXAM10: Explore cho multi-phase verbose discovery.

skills.item: Combining plan mode for investigation with direct execution for implementation (e.g., planning a library migration, then executing the planned approach)
skills.evidence: EXAM10/API30: investigation plan rồi execution phương án đã chọn.

title: Apply iterative re fi nement techniques for progressive improvement
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Concrete input/output examples as the most effective way to communicate expected transformations when prose descriptions are interpreted inconsistently
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: cặp input/output thay prose mơ hồ.

knowledge.item: Test-driven iteration: writing test suites fi rst, then iterating by sharing test failures to guide progressive improvement
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13/API30: meaningful tests trước code, failures hướng sửa.

knowledge.item: The interview pattern: having Claude ask questions to surface considerations the developer may not have anticipated before implementing
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: interview lộ cache invalidation/failure modes.

knowledge.item: When to provide all issues in a single message (interacting problems) versus fi xing them sequentially (independent problems)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: interacting issues cùng message, independent tuần tự.

skills.item: Providing 2-3 concrete input/output examples to clarify transformation requirements when natural language descriptions produce inconsistent results
skills.evidence: EXAM13/16Q2: 2–3 cặp input/output đã review.

skills.item: Writing test suites covering expected behavior, edge cases, and performance requirements before implementation, then iterating by sharing test failures
skills.evidence: EXAM13: hành vi/edge/performance test phù hợp rồi expected/actual failure.

skills.item: Using the interview pattern to surface design considerations (e.g., cache invalidation strategies, failure modes) before implementing solutions in unfamiliar domains
skills.evidence: EXAM13: interview lĩnh vực chưa quen trước quyết định thiết kế.

skills.item: Providing speci fi c test cases with example input and expected output to fi x edge case handling (e.g., null values in migration scripts)
skills.evidence: EXAM13/16Q2: null giữ null, phân biệt chuỗi rỗng và chuỗi null.

skills.item: Addressing multiple interacting issues in a single detailed message when fi xes interact, versus sequential iteration for independent issues
skills.evidence: EXAM13: phối hợp issues cùng pipeline khi fix ảnh hưởng nhau.

title: Integrate Claude Code into CI/CD pipelines
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The -p (or --print) fl ag for running Claude Code in non-interactive mode in automated pipelines
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13/CODE06: -p/--print non-interactive.

knowledge.item: --output-format json and --json-schema CLI fl ags for enforcing structured output in CI contexts
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13/CODE06: --output-format json và --json-schema; envelope khác payload.

knowledge.item: CLAUDE.md as the mechanism for providing project context (testing standards, fi xture conventions, review criteria) to CI-invoked Claude Code
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: project standards/fixtures/review criteria trong CLAUDE.md.

knowledge.item: Session context isolation: why the same Claude session that generated code is less effective at reviewing its own changes compared to an independent review instance
knowledge.evidence: EXAM08/13/16: reviewer instance riêng tránh context sinh code.

skills.item: Running Claude Code in CI with the -p fl ag to prevent interactive input hangs
skills.evidence: EXAM16Q3/CODE06: -p cho unattended, tránh chờ UI.

skills.item: Using --output-format json with --json-schema to produce machine-parseable structured fi ndings for automated posting as inline PR comments
skills.evidence: EXAM13: validate findings file/location/schema trước adapter inline comment theo quyền.

skills.item: Including prior review fi ndings in context when re-running reviews after new commits, instructing Claude to report only new or still-unaddressed issues to avoid duplicate comments

skills.item: Providing existing test fi les in context so test generation avoids suggesting duplicate scenarios already covered by the test suite

skills.item: Documenting testing standards, valuable test criteria, and available fi xtures in CLAUDE.md to improve test generation quality and reduce low-value test output
